name: fluted-glass-waves-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Fluted Glass style. Waves variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#000000, #1F51FF, #00E5FF, #EAFDFF). Features: cursor-reactive (push). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
